from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """The information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document as written (e.g. '《判决文书 1》')")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action explicitly stated in the document (e.g. '不动产登记纠纷', '继承纠纷')")
    case_nature: str | None = Field(description="The broader legal nature of the case (e.g. 'Administrative', 'Enforcement', 'Civil', 'Personality Right')")
    key_procedural_facts: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of key legal procedures or disputes (e.g. 'Review of lower court enforcement objection ruling')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted document cases."""
    cases: list[DocumentCase] = Field(description="List of document cases extracted from the provided documents")
